description: Run this after every code change in this Vue project, before committing, before opening a PR, or whenever the user says "verify", "check", "lint", "run tests", "build", "audit". Diff audit (router guards, store boundaries, UX, /ui consistency, error handling) → lint → tests + coverage gate → build. Coverage drops → add tests, never lower thresholds. Triggers on "is this ready to commit?", "any issues?", "tests passing?".
